targets.name: monthly_active_revenue
targets.title: Monthly active net revenue report (SQL)
targets.summary: Rewrite monthly_active_revenue query.sql to lower its SQLite query-plan cost (fewer full-table scans and correlated subqueries) while matching the exact reference result set across all seeded datasets.
targets.approach: Submit one read-only SELECT or WITH query (no comments, no semicolons) matching reference.sql output exactly with a lower SQLite query-plan cost: VDBE opcode count, +500 per SCAN, +900 per correlated subquery, +20 per SEARCH, +100 per temp B-tree. This is a heuristic over EXPLAIN output, not measured runtime or I/O.
